title: Multiplayer typing
heroDescription: Got a code? Join your friends in their lobby.
createDescription: Your room, your crew. Bring everyone together around the keyboard.
joinDescription: Enter the code shared by your host.
guestDescription: Enter your room code, then pick a nickname and a character.
accountRequired: Sign in to an account to create your room.
footerTagline: A code, some friends, and you’re in!
loginDescription: Sign in and get your room ready.
signupDescription: An account to create your own rooms.
loginPrompt: Already have an account? Sign in.
shareCode: Share this code to invite your friends.
guestLimit: Guests can join a room, but cannot create one.
guestWarning: Sign out before creating or signing into an account. Your guest identity will not be merged.
noRecovery: Email is required at signup. Password recovery is not available.
roomIntro: Create a room or join with its code.
roomConflict: You are already in a room. Leave it before joining another.

errors.VALIDATION: Check the values and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Sign in again or check your username and password.
errors.CONFLICT: The request conflicts with the current state. You may already be in a room.
errors.ROOM_FULL: This room has no participant slots left.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: My profile
profile.editDescription: The name your crew sees, and a photo that feels like you.
profile.nameHint: 3–20 characters. Your sign-in username stays the same.
profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 2 MB. Cropped to a square.
profile.photoError: Choose a photo no larger than 2 MB.
profile.validationError: Use a name of 3–20 characters and a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP photo up to 2 MB.
profile.signInNotice: Sign in to see and edit your profile.
profile.guestNotice: Profiles are for accounts. As a guest, you can join a room without a personal photo or saved race history.
profile.statsUnavailable: Stats will be available when races are ready.
profile.progressUnavailable: Your WPM over time will appear here once races and results are available.
profile.historyUnavailable: Race history will be available when races are ready.

play.entryEyebrow: A spot at the starting line
play.entryDescription: One room. Your people. Find your way in.
play.roomCodeHint: Enter your host’s 6-character code. No 0, O, 1, I or L.
play.editorDescription: Choose your character, then meet the crew.
